description: This file contains device-specific network bridge utility functions for Raspberry Pi, including MAC address management, IP configuration, and bridge setup routines, with platform-specific handling for OVS and brctl.

methods.name: GetCmdOutput
methods.description: Executes a shell command and captures its output into a string buffer.

methods.name: isFileExistsAccess
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: GetBaseMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the base MAC address from the device's network interface.

methods.name: GetUpdatedMacAddress
methods.description: Calculates a new MAC address based on a base MAC and an offset.

methods.name: SetMacAddress
methods.description: Assigns a MAC address to a network interface.

methods.name: SetIpAddress
methods.description: Sets IP address, subnet mask, and broadcast address for a given interface.

methods.name: AssignMacForLanBridge
methods.description: Calculates and sets a MAC address for a LAN bridge interface.

methods.name: EnableIPForward
methods.description: Enables IP forwarding in the Linux kernel.

methods.name: HandlePreConfigVendor
methods.description: Performs pre-configuration steps for network bridges, such as cleanup and platform-specific setup.

methods.name: HandlePostConfigVendor
methods.description: Performs post-configuration steps for network bridges, such as MAC address assignment, IP setup, and interface activation.
